messages:
maria (infra): Observed sudden capacity drop in us-east2. ~18% of GPU capacity flagged DEGRADED since 06:22Z. ECC counters spiking on rack-7 GPUs, repeated Xid 13/63 patterns. 24/128 GPUs in rack-7 currently drained. Can we triage?

sre-bot: Alert: GPU-ECC-Spike us-east2 triggered 06:25Z. Severity: high. Affected nodes: rack-7-[1..8]. Autoscale actions: auto-drain initiated.

raj (oncall): I'm on it. @jen can you run the probe and nvml-check on rack-7? Also hold any canary rollouts targeting us-east2.

jen (runtime): Running probe now: ```./tools/gpu-probe --rack rack-7 --output short``` Getting ECC deltas: cards 1-8 -> +120..+560 errors in last 30m. Temps normal (64-70C). Fans look fine.

kyle (platform): Can we smart-route traffic off us-east2 for non-SLA classes? Recommend set avoid-us-east2 policy for next 2h and spin burst capacity in us-west as buffer.

maria (infra): Started isolation steps: cordoned nodes gpu-r7-3,gpu-r7-5,gpu-r7-6 and kicked replacement flow from spare-pool. Command used: `kubectl drain node/gpu-r7-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

ops-bot: NOTE: drain actions will temporarily reduce capacity by ~6%. Autoscaler paused for rack-7 during manual intervention.

raj (oncall): Any recent driver/firmware rollouts in us-east2? Could this be a soft-ecc regression (we saw something similar with driver 535.80 earlier).

jen (runtime): No driver changes in region in last 48h. Vendor ticket open (#HW-3982). Preliminary vendor triage suspects degrading memory modules on subset of A6000 blades; RMA requested.

hardware-support: We need NVML dumps + serials. maria, can you run `python3 scripts/nvml_dump.py --nodes gpu-r7-* > /tmp/r7-nvml.log` and attach?

maria (infra): Attached snippet to incident store: ```NVML: GPU 3 serial SN12345 ECC_COUNT=412 Xid=63 ts=2026-03-18T06:18:12Z``` Uploaded full dump to /internal/incident/1979999999/logs.

raj (oncall): Short-term mitigations: 1) KV-cache bypass for generation endpoints routed to rack-7 to reduce retries (latency tradeoff), 2) throttle telemetry duplicate Xid alerts to avoid alert storms. Applying KV-bypass on routes now.

kyle (platform): Routing note: shifting traffic to us-west/west2 estimated cost +$120/hr on burst nodes at current load (~60k tokens/min). Finance notified.

jen (runtime): Scheduling vendor-led blade swaps tonight 02:00Z. Plan: rolling blade RMA, keep 1 spare per rack, vendor tech on site. I'll coordinate with ops.

maria (infra): Adding telemetry filter to suppress noisy Xid-13 duplicates while we triage: `telemetryctl throttle --signal XID_13 --window 60s --threshold 5`

sre-bot: Alert throttle applied for XID_13. Future alerts will be on ECC aggregate delta only.

raj (oncall): Status update: current capacity drop ~18%. After drains + replacement plan, expected rebound to ~95% capacity within 6-8h. Keeping this channel for updates. Tagging @oncall @hardware-support @finance.

kyle (platform): Thanks all. Please post a short incident note for infra-ops Slack #incidents once we lock timeline. :pray:

jen (runtime): Acknowledged. Will post runbook and RMA schedule in 30m. :thumbsup:

maria (infra): Will follow up with serials and per-node ECC graphs. Moving to replacement window at 02:00Z.

raj (oncall): Closing loop for now — monitoring. If ECC deltas spike again, we escalate to P1 and open cross-team war room.

kyle (platform): 👍
